show.en: The school show happens once at the end of every term.
show.cn: 学校汇演每学期末举行一次。

prepare.en: We have been preparing for this show for three weeks.
prepare.cn: 我们为这次演出准备了三周。

act.en: He acts as the kind king in our school play.
act.cn: 他在校园剧中扮演善良的国王。

audience.en: The audience filled every seat in the school hall.
audience.cn: 观众坐满了学校礼堂的每个座位。

clap.en: Parents stood up and clapped for a long time.
clap.cn: 家长们站起来鼓了很久的掌。

remember.en: I will remember this school show for many years.
remember.cn: 这场校园汇演我会记很多年。
